description: Bytecode Compiler and Stack-based Virtual Machine - Compile TinyLang AST to bytecode instructions and execute them on a stack-based VM. This is a major new component that enables tinylang compile and tinylang exec commands.
steps: Create src/compiler/ directory with bytecode instruction set definition in src/compiler/opcodes.ts. Define opcodes: CONST, POP, ADD, SUB, MUL, DIV, MOD, POW, NEGATE, NOT, EQ, NEQ, LT, LTE, GT, GTE, AND, OR, JMP, JMP_IF_FALSE, JMP_IF_TRUE, LOAD_LOCAL, STORE_LOCAL, LOAD_GLOBAL, STORE_GLOBAL, CALL, RETURN, ARRAY, OBJECT, INDEX, SET_INDEX, GET_PROP, SET_PROP, PRINT, CLOSURE, CLASS, METHOD, INHERIT, NEW_INSTANCE, DUP, HALT

Create src/compiler/chunk.ts - Bytecode chunk that holds instructions (Uint8Array), a constant pool (RuntimeValue[]), line number mapping for error messages, and serialization/deserialization to .tinyc binary format

Create src/compiler/compiler.ts - AST visitor that walks the parsed AST and emits bytecode instructions. Handle all Statement and Expression types from src/types/ast.ts. Track local variable scopes with a compile-time symbol table. Support closures by emitting CLOSURE instructions that capture upvalues. Handle classes, methods, inheritance.

Create src/vm/vm.ts - Stack-based virtual machine. Maintain an operand stack, call frame stack (each frame has its own instruction pointer, base pointer, local slots). Implement execution loop that fetches/decodes/executes each opcode. Handle function calls with CALL/RETURN. Implement garbage collection via reference counting on heap-allocated objects (arrays, objects, closures, instances).
Create src/vm/index.ts that exports the VM class
Create src/compiler/index.ts that exports Compiler and related types

Create src/compiler/disassembler.ts - Human-readable disassembly of bytecode chunks, showing instruction offset, opcode name, operands, and corresponding source line. Format: 0000 CONST 0 (line 1) followed by the constant value.

Create src/compiler/optimizer.ts - Optimization passes: constant folding (compile-time evaluate constant expressions), dead code elimination (remove code after unconditional return/break), strength reduction (replace pow(x,2) with x*x). Run between compilation and VM execution.
Integrate into src/tinylang.ts: add compile(source: string) method that returns a Chunk, and execVM(chunk: Chunk) method. Also add a compileAndRun(source: string) method.

Add tests in tests/compiler/compiler.test.ts testing compilation of expressions, statements, control flow, functions, classes. Verify correct bytecode sequences and that VM execution produces same results as tree-walk interpreter.
Add tests in tests/vm/vm.test.ts testing the VM execution of pre-compiled chunks, covering arithmetic, control flow, function calls, closures, class instantiation.
Create the binary .tinyc format: magic bytes 'TINY' + version byte + serialized constant pool + instruction bytes. Add serialize/deserialize methods to Chunk class.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build succeeds with no type errors
Running npx vitest run passes all existing 124 tests plus new compiler/VM tests
Compiling a program with the Compiler class produces a valid Chunk
Executing the Chunk on the VM produces identical output to the tree-walk interpreter for all 10 example programs
The disassembler produces readable bytecode output
Optimization passes demonstrably reduce instruction count for constant expressions
.tinyc files can be serialized and deserialized correctly
verification: node -e "const {TinyLang} = require('./dist'); const tl = new TinyLang(); console.log(tl.compile('let x = 1 + 2; print(x)'))"
findings: Pre-existing parser bug: using 'toString' as a method name causes the parser to infinite loop (conflict with JS Object.prototype.toString). Tests use 'toStr' as workaround. The parser uses => syntax for match cases (not braces). STORE_LOCAL/STORE_GLOBAL in VM consume (pop) the top of stack. For local variable declarations the value stays on stack as the slot. All 124 original tests pass plus 99 new tests (223 total).
